bestBets.overview: OMNIC comes here with two gutsy runs at the track over the distance and beaten under half a length in each. Keeps finding when asked. Last run was a two horse war with third placegetter five lengths away. BELLABAMA scored a very easy win last start coming off a month break into 1600m  so rise in distance unlikely to be a factor. Previous placing was against horse who then performed in metro midweek class. KIWI JENNI moved home very nicely at the end of 1600m (best last 200m of the meeting) so looks ready for the longer trip and has a good foundation of runs for it. PRINCESS SAKIKO peaks at run four and back on the turf. Last preparation found good form over 1600m prior to spelling. HAWK POWER is definitely better on soft tracks than the true heavy decks. Strong 1600m winner in higher grade last start and no problems with the extra trip as a 2000m performer. RAGAZZONE goes well for Hurdle and came through a useful race last start.

raceTips.comment: Kiwi Jenni does look as though she’s still learning, but she’s simply been too far back in slowly run races. If she can present within striking distance at the top of the straight, she can win. Hawk Power looks the value in the races. He carries the full top weight but his last start win in this grade was solid, and has had a tick over jump out since. His form from earlier this prep is strong, not far behind the likes of Foire De Trone and Straand Deal. Omnic is racing very well and consistently at this track and will put himself on speed again. Bellabama was a soft MDN winner last start and can go on with it. Annabelle Sunshine is so honest and will be in the mix again
